description: Source code for the Zephyr driver for Bosch BMP388 pressure sensor, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and calibration handling.

methods.name: bmp388_reg_field_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register with a mask and value.

methods.name: bmp388_freq_to_odr_val
methods.description: Converts frequency to ODR register value.

methods.name: bmp388_attr_set_odr
methods.description: Sets output data rate based on frequency.

methods.name: bmp388_attr_set_oversampling
methods.description: Configures oversampling for pressure or temperature channels.

methods.name: bmp388_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes like sampling frequency and oversampling.

methods.name: bmp388_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches raw sensor data and stores it.

methods.name: bmp388_compensate_temp
methods.description: Calculates compensated temperature from raw data.

methods.name: bmp388_compensate_press
methods.description: Calculates compensated pressure from raw data.

methods.name: bmp388_channel_get
methods.description: Gets sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: bmp388_get_calibration_data
methods.description: Reads calibration data from sensor registers.

methods.name: bmp388_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the device.
